genotypes_attribution: The 1000 Genomes Project Consortium, 'A global reference for human genetic variation', Nature 526:68-74 (2015), doi:10.1038/nature15393.
modifications: The 183 of PGS000072's 187 published variants that Ensembl's 1000 Genomes phase 3 records resolve are scored, with their weights unchanged; the other 4 are listed in variants_unscored and left out. The dosages are effect-allele counts from 1000 Genomes phase 3 genotypes read through the Ensembl REST API; 30 of 2504 individuals are included.
provenance: real 1000 Genomes phase-3 genotypes (no licence instrument: open-consent data, per IGSR's disclaimer; The 1000 Genomes Project Consortium, Nature 526:68-74, 2015) + the published PGS000072 effect weights (PGS Catalog; Graff et al., Nat Commun 12:970, 2021, CC BY 4.0). 183 of its 187 variants are scored: the 4 that Ensembl's 1000 Genomes records do not resolve are left out, not filled in. 30 of 2,504 individuals ship in the browser payload - DATA_LICENSES section 4 justifies a slice of that size, not the full matrix.
reference_note: Each shipped individual's super-population is the 1000 Genomes label of the population it was sampled in (IGSR's panel), not one inferred from its genotypes. The statistics are over all 2504 individuals of the panel, the scored person included.
